answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 12677 Country: Canada Title: How did Rasulullah (SAW) bathe in his time? Question: How did Rasulullah (SAW) bathe in his time? Answer ID: 12677 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 772/718=B/1430) First, he would wash the private part, and then would wash the hands rubbing them with soil. Thereafter, he used to perform wudhu just like salah. Then, he used to pour water on head, right shoulder and left shoulder. Thus, he used to rub the body and pour water thrice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
